title: 第15章 下楼电梯惊变第16章 楼下诡影初相逢
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
就在李笑笑察觉到不对，警惕抬头打量周围的时候，在百叶窗之后观察的孟天，却是不禁心中微动。
随着李笑笑的心情起伏变化，孟天清晰的感受到，一缕缕的精神能量，不断的从李笑笑身上溢出，融入死亡空间之中。
很快，孟天便猜出了大概缘由。
如今的李笑笑，可是处在他的死亡空间，而不是其自己梦境之中的。
其在受到惊吓，精神波动所溢散的精神能量，在离开身体的瞬间，就开始被死亡空间快速的同化融合了。
根本来不及凝聚能量光球，就已经彻底融入死亡空间了。
只要不是受到巨大惊吓，瞬间溢散大量的精神能量，死亡空间来不及完全的同化融合，李笑笑以后都将不会掉落能量光球。
不过，这对孟天并没有什么影响，反而省下了拾取能量光球的时间。
至于李笑笑出现在这里的原因，孟天同样有了大致推测。
无外乎就是当李笑笑睡着的时候，就会自然而然的，和原来是其梦境空间的经理办公室共鸣，最终进入死亡空间，而不是形成新的梦境空间。
做出这个推测之后，孟天不禁心中一喜。
这代表他在以后，都将拥有一个稳定的能量来源。
孟天看向李笑笑的眼神，都是不禁带上了一抹温柔。
他决定了，以后就对她好一点。
嗯，悠着点吓！
而就在孟天思绪翻滚的时候，李笑笑的眼神扫过了他的方向。
然后，李笑笑双眼猛的瞪大，瞳孔紧缩。
“经理…”
李笑笑心中恐惧滋生。
看着经理办公室，还有那百叶窗露出的两个眼睛，她在此时终于是想起了昨日的梦境。

“我这是在做梦？…
我肯定是又做噩梦了！
醒过来，醒过来…”
李笑笑内心呐喊，无形的空间涟漪微微波动。
但是她却并没有就此离开。
这里是孟天的死亡空间，而不是她的梦境空间，哪怕意识到了真相，她也无法苏醒过来，除非孟天同意。
或者，她在这里受到致死的伤害，乃至是死亡，才会让她如今的身体崩溃，意识在现实苏醒过来。
嗯，她如今的身体，就是自身精神能量凝聚的精神能量体，或者说是灵魂之体，灵体。
本来，她的大部分精神能量，应该都是演化为梦境空间的。
只有很少的一小部分精神能量，化作梦境空间的梦主。
而此时，本来应该演化梦境空间的所有精神能量，全部与她的意识融合，演化了如今的灵体身体。
而这也是，她能够维持清醒的一个原因。
不过哪怕如此，她与现实身体的联系，也不是孟天以及死亡空间可以隔断的。
因此，当其死亡的瞬间，意识就会重新返回，根本不会有任何影响，最多就是受点惊吓而已。
至于损耗的精神能量，恐怕和普通人做噩梦也没有区别。
虚幻的精神，又如何及得上真实身体拥有的能量？
除此之外，若是她在现实的身体受到惊扰，身体本能的拉扯，也会让她瞬间挣脱死亡空间的束缚，重新回到现实身体。
现实的比重，超过孟天所在梦境虚空太多太多了。
因此，在这里发生的一切，都不会影响现实。
现实的变化，却会对这里造成莫大影响。

比如李笑笑蕴含的能量，哪怕因为恐惧不断被死亡空间吸收，但其体内能量却丝毫没有减少。
content_en:
Just when Li Xiaoxiao noticed something was wrong and raised his head to look around cautiously, Meng Tian, ​​who was observing behind the blinds, couldn't help but feel a slight movement in his heart.
As Li Xiaoxiao's mood fluctuated, Meng Tian clearly felt that wisps of spiritual energy were constantly overflowing from Li Xiaoxiao's body and blending into the death space.
Soon, Meng Tian guessed the general reason.
Li Xiaoxiao now is in his death space, not in his own dream.
When he was frightened, the spiritual energy spilled from his mental fluctuations began to be rapidly assimilated and fused by the death space the moment it left the body.
There was no time to condense the energy light ball before it was completely integrated into the dead space.
As long as he is not greatly frightened and a large amount of spiritual energy is released in an instant, and the dead space has no time to completely assimilate and fuse, Li Xiaoxiao will never drop energy light balls in the future.
However, this had no impact on Meng Tian. Instead, it saved the time of picking up the energy light ball.
As for the reason why Li Xiaoxiao appeared here, Meng Tian also had a rough guess.
It is nothing more than that when Li Xiaoxiao falls asleep, he will naturally resonate with the manager's office that was originally his dream space, and eventually enter the death space instead of forming a new dream space.
After making this speculation, Meng Tian couldn't help but feel happy.
This means that he will have a stable source of energy in the future.
Meng Tian couldn't help but look at Li Xiaoxiao with a touch of tenderness.
He decided to treat her better in the future.
Well, take it easy and be scared!
Just as Meng Tian's thoughts were swirling, Li Xiaoxiao's eyes glanced in his direction.
Then, Li Xiaoxiao's eyes suddenly widened and his pupils tightened.
"Manager..."
Fear grew in Li Xiaoxiao's heart.
Looking at the manager's office and the two eyes exposed through the blinds, she finally remembered yesterday's dream.
"Am I dreaming?...
I must be having another nightmare!
Wake up, wake up..."
Li Xiaoxiao shouted in his heart, and the invisible ripples in the space rippled slightly.
But she didn't leave just yet.
This is Meng Tian's death space, not her dream space. Even if she realizes the truth, she cannot wake up unless Meng Tian agrees.
Or maybe she suffered fatal injuries here, or even died, which would cause her current body to collapse and her consciousness to wake up in reality.
Well, her current body is a spiritual energy body condensed with her own spiritual energy, or a soul body or a spiritual body.
Originally, most of her spiritual energy should have evolved into the dream space.
Only a small part of the spiritual energy turns into the dream master of the dream space.
At this time, all the spiritual energy that was supposed to evolve into the dream space merged with her consciousness and evolved into the current spiritual body.
And this is one of the reasons why she can stay awake.
But even so, her connection with the real body cannot be cut off by Meng Tian and the Death Space.
Therefore, when it dies, its consciousness will return again, and there will be no impact at all. At most, it will only be a little frightened.
As for the mental energy consumed, it is probably no different from ordinary people having nightmares.
How can the illusory spirit compare to the energy possessed by the real body?
In addition, if she is disturbed in her real body, the instinctive pull of her body will also cause her to instantly break free from the shackles of the death space and return to her real body.
The weight of reality is much greater than the void in Meng Tian's dream.
Therefore, nothing that happens here will affect reality.
Changes in reality will have a huge impact here.
For example, the energy contained in Li Xiaoxiao, even though it was constantly being absorbed by the dead space due to fear, the energy in his body did not decrease at all.
